items.title: Nvidia-Backed Cohere Says IPO Timing Uncertain Despite Surging Revenue
items.teaser: Canadian artificial-intelligence company Cohere’s timeline for going public remains uncertain despite surging revenue, its chief executive said, as the startup draws fresh backing from Nvidia and the Canadian government.

items.title: Zipline Reaches $21.5 Billion Valuation as Drone Delivery Gains Traction
items.teaser: Chief Executive Keller Cliffton, who co-founded Zipline in 2014, said the company’s skyrocketing valuation is a sign that autonomous delivery has finally gained wider acceptance among both investors and commercial partners.

items.title: Wendy’s Rejects Trian’s $1.4 Billion Takeover Offer
items.teaser: The struggling burger chain backed its own turnaround bid instead of being taken private by Nelson Peltz’s hedge fund.

items.title: Ethan Allen Shareholders Hand Board Control to Activist Investor Doug Bergeron
items.teaser: Bergeron said the new board will focus on strengthening corporate governance, returning to profitable growth, and selecting a successor to CEO Farooq Kathwari.

items.teaser: U.S. stocks are surging as investors react to a blue wave that puts Democrats in control of both chambers of Congress.

items.title: Carlyle Shares Slump On Bigger-Than-Expected Drop in Fees
items.teaser: Carlyle Group Inc. shares fell the most in more than a year after the firm reported a bigger-than-expected drop in a key measure of earnings as a slew of exits left the firm with fewer fee-generating assets.
